title: insonic durable job event
description: Versioned ordered event for a durable job/attempt. Event syntax does not establish a committed catalog or graph result: publication receipts/checkpoints and application state transitions retain that authority.

schema_version.description: Version of this insonic document contract.

kind.description: Document discriminator registered by the master schema.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing sequence within this job event stream; application rejects duplicate/conflicting sequence content.

occurred_at.description: UTC audit instant emitted by the runtime.

event_type.description: Declared event type controlling required detail fields.

state.description: Durable application job state after the event; application enforces valid transitions.

attempt_id.description: Producing attempt identity, absent before the first claim.

attempt_number.description: One-based attempt count for this job.

claim_generation.description: Fencing generation of the worker claim; stale claims cannot commit newer state.

progress.description: Adapter-reported progress; absence is distinct from zero progress.

fraction.description: Fraction complete when the adapter supplies a meaningful denominator.

total_units.description: Positive expected quantity when known; application additionally checks completed <= total.

unit.description: Unit for quantities, such as seconds, segments or training steps.

message.description: Plain-language progress message excluding secrets and full source/transcript payloads.

artifact_refs.description: Immutable artifact references produced by this event, not temporary paths.

checkpoint_id.description: Catalog checkpoint record ID, including hosted checkpoints without downloadable bytes.

error.description: Redacted actionable failure details; unknown commit outcomes remain explicitly reconcilable.

category.description: Failure boundary used by recovery and user guidance.

message.description: Readable next-action message without credential values or whole transcripts.

retryable.description: Whether the configured retry policy can retry this operation without rerouting.

operation_id.description: Operation receipt to reconcile when commit status is unknown.

publication.description: Catalog-to-graph publication state associated with this event.

catalog_revision.description: Exact accepted catalog revision awaiting or completing projection.

status.description: Publication state; committed means the matching checkpoint has been verified.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension data without changing event/query authority.
